value.rationale: Degree-one Walsh characters on the full ambient binary matrix space are canonical low-frequency measurements. Restriction to Sp(d,2), a natural symplectic symmetry constraint, makes their exact spectral stability non-obvious; the claim supplies all Riesz eigenvalues/equality spaces and a strict cutoff m=4 between two instability modes. It is an all-rank theorem with a meaningful invariant, not a small numeric table or routine correction.
